title: 姚明：库里签约李宁，中美体育文化交融
speaker: Yao Ming

segments.en: We're also kind of to a certain extent seeing the reverse of that. We're seeing US players now getting endorsement deals with Chinese firms, and I am curious as to what you see over there with regards to how younger consumers, the types of brands they're looking for, the types of products they're looking for.
segments.zh: 我们也看到了一种反向趋势。美国球员现在开始与中国公司签约代言，我很好奇你那边的情况，年轻消费者在寻找什么样的品牌和产品？

segments.en: It's a very nice interaction. Stephen Curry just signed with Lee Nimbrane, which is a huge impact. Everybody is excited about it.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常好的互动。斯蒂芬·库里刚刚签约了李宁，影响巨大。每个人都很兴奋。

segments.en: Lee Nimbrane, he's founder of Mr. Lee Nimbrane, is a national hero for us. When I was young, he won the title back to 1984 in Los Angeles, and he's a national hero for us.
segments.zh: 李宁，李宁品牌的创始人，是我们的民族英雄。我小时候，他在1984年洛杉矶奥运会上夺冠，他是我们的民族英雄。

segments.en: And now, imagine those, and there's a hero from older generation to the current generation that really make a lot of a...
segments.zh: 现在想象一下，从老一辈英雄到新一代，这真的产生了很大的影响……

segments.en: I'm sure there will be a very successful cooperation, and I really think that there will be not only one, there will be more coming.
segments.zh: 我相信这将会是一次非常成功的合作，而且我认为这不会是唯一一次，未来还会有更多。
